colourHandling.baseColour: Six original variants preserve their manually selected illustrative sRGB hex values. Eighty additional variants use rounded arithmetic means of their verified company JPEG display RGB channels, stored as indicative sRGB hex values on ProductVariant.hex. Three ColorManagement converts these hex inputs to the linear working space. This display workflow is not source-profile verification, colour calibration or measured material capture.
colourHandling.sourceSwatches: Source JPEGs remain separate 2D browser references. Embedded source profile, physical calibration and exact colour are not established. Published highlights or patterns are not applied as textures or treated as measured material properties.

textureAssets.calibration: not supplied; no measured maps generated

parameterProvenance: Engineering illustration only, not derived from industrial gloss figures or calibrated measurements.
environment: Three RoomEnvironment with two shared procedural softbox reflection cards; not photographed on-site or measured for these materials

environmentSettings.calibrationStatus: illustrative; generated without measured source lighting
environmentSettings.reflectionCardScope: Identical for all variants and comparison copies; face environment capture origin. Cards are included only in procedural lighting, never as scene furniture, material maps or measured finish data. RoomEnvironment.dispose releases their geometry and materials after PMREM generation.

shadows.updatePolicy: fixed shadow maps cached; refresh on geometry or lighting changes, never on camera orbit

geometry: Generic furniture substrate constructed in metres: flat furniture-front panel with visible edge and stand, kitchen vignette with door/drawer gaps and fixed hardware, furniture unit with fixed legs and backdrop, rectangular table with a visible substrate edge and four legs. Surface film is applied only to front/accent slots, with the table fronts slot limited to its horizontal top. Sink, handles, bodies, walls, floors, frames and hardware are fixed illustration geometry. Demo dimensions, thickness and edges establish no industrial processing capability, application suitability or product specification.
furnitureCarcassGeometry: A single 2.48 x 0.85 x 0.53 metre illustrative carcass provides the unit sides and back. A separate narrower front reveal plate (2.452 x 0.826 x 0.004 metres, centre Z 0.265 metres) provides dark door gaps without coplanar side/back surfaces. Front assignments and identical comparison geometry are preserved. These are demonstration furniture dimensions, not product manufacturing data.
tableGeometry: Generic 1.9 x 0.95 metre rectangular tabletop with its upper film face at 0.78 metres above the floor. The fixed 0.035 metre substrate has a separate inset 1.894 x 0.944 x 0.002 metre illustrative film face, with no wrapping, edge-forming or technical thickness claim. Only this top uses the fronts assignment; no accent slot exists. Apron, four slim legs, feet, substrate edge, walls and floor are fixed. Comparison copies share the same geometry, responsive lens, stored camera, lighting, material implementation and capture path. No scene assets, texture maps or external downloads are added. Demonstrating a table does not establish the film's industrial processing or table-application suitability.
comparison: Same stored camera coordinates, responsive lens, viewport aspect, geometry, tone mapping, exposure, environment and lights for both halves. Explicit accent assignment stays fixed; otherwise each copy uses its own front variant for the accent. Default vertical field of view is 35 degrees; narrow viewports use fov = 2atan(tan(35deg/2) * max(1, 1.05/aspect)). Responsive framing changes the lens equally for both copies, never their saved positions.
performance: No external scene/model/texture downloads and no generated material maps. Renderer/environment persist across selections; substrate rebuilds only on scene changes. Both copies share geometry buffers. Demand rendering stops at rest and pauses for hidden documents or offscreen canvas. Camera commands use a transient 280ms ease; reduced-motion commands are instant. Mobile classification follows viewport <=768px or coarse pointer and is refreshed on resize/preference changes. DPR <=1.5 on mobile and <=2 on desktop; movement rendering ceiling <=30 FPS on mobile. Resources and observers are disposed on teardown. Context-loss cleanup checks current context and extension support; missing material assets or render failures lead to the 2D fallback.
limitations: Illustrative preview — verify with a physical sample. Exact matching requires approved measurement workflow.

sourceDerivedColourWorkflow.input: Verified 200 x 200 JPEG swatch from the actual current rendered Frosted/Matt or Gloss/Hochglanz source card; source URL, file dimensions, hash and byte count remain in production-catalog-import.json.
sourceDerivedColourWorkflow.extraction: Arithmetic mean of all decoded JPEG pixels in each display RGB channel, rounded to 8-bit values and serialized as #RRGGBB. Existing computed means are reused without changing any source file.
sourceDerivedColourWorkflow.rendering: Uniform illustrative colour only, with the existing shared generic finish response and identical renderer implementation for product previews, Studio scenes and comparison.
sourceDerivedColourWorkflow.excludedInterpretations: Source means include published highlights or patterns and cannot recover measured base colour. No source thumbnail is used as a surface map; no procedural grain, normal, roughness, clearcoat, metallic, pearl or glass property is inferred from a name or image. Physical scale, calibration and UV orientation remain unknown.
sourceDerivedColourWorkflow.limits: All previews are illustrative display approximations. They do not establish exact colour, measured finish response, pattern fidelity, industrial suitability, product family, physical dimensions or forming capability. Verify with a physical sample and an owner-approved measurement workflow.

preservedOriginalMaterials.provenance: Original manually selected illustrative colours and generic finish parameters remain unchanged for saved-study appearance compatibility.
